problem.lead: A hungry person isn't looking for a restaurant — they want a fast, confident decision. But no tool solves that.

launch.pwaDesc: Installs to your phone from the browser in one tap. Works offline too.

install.title: Up and running in a minute
install.subtitle: Telegram is the easiest way. To install the app on your phone, follow the steps below.

tg.title: Via Telegram
steps: Done — the app runs inside Telegram

android.title: Install on Android
steps: Open the app in the Chrome browser
Tap “Install app” (or ⋮ menu → “Add to Home screen”)
The FoodGPT icon appears on your home screen

ios.title: Install on iPhone
ios.note: On iPhone, only the Safari browser works
steps: Tap the “Share” button at the bottom
